an4.168:1.1: athakho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.168:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
an4.168:2.8: imāsaṃ āvuso catassannaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamaṃ te paṭipadaṃ āgamma anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
an4.168:3.3: dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā
an4.168:3.5: imāsaṃ āvuso catassannaṃ paṭipadānaṃ yāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā khippābhiññā imaṃ me paṭipadaṃ āgamma anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
